title: Thai-Style Flaky Fish Cakes with Prik Sauce
description: Crispy fish cakes served with a spicy and sour prik sauce, inspired by the flavors of Thailand.
instructions: 1. In a food processor, pulse the fish until it breaks down into small pieces.
2. Add the tofu, curry paste, nam prik sauce, fish sauce, and brown sugar to the food processor. Pulse until well combined.
3. Stir in the chopped cilantro and peanuts, if using.
4. Divide the mixture into 8 portions and shape each portion into a patty.
5. Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
6. When the oil is hot, add the patties and cook for about 3-4 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
7. Serve the fish cakes hot with additional prik sauce for dipping, if desired.
